name: stage_1_stand_permissive
description: Permissive standing stage — full legacy reward density so brain bootstraps standing pose without competing pressures.  Auto-advance after 30 sec CUMULATIVE upright (1800 ticks @ 60Hz).  standing_baseline_factor=1.0 + gated_walk_bonus_rate=0 preserves byte-identical behaviour vs the legacy stand_walk_distance curriculum during this stage.

name: stage_2_walk_multiplicative_gate
description:
Phase 7.5.R terminal stage — multiplicative-gating reward shape (Option 2).

  standing_baseline_factor = 0.25  ⇒ pure-standing density = 0.20 × 0.25 = 0.05 hits/tick.
                                     Standing alone is still rewarded (~25% of legacy), so cold-start pose isn't lost,
                                     but it's no longer the dominant attractor.
  walk_hit_rate            = 0.05  ⇒ legacy radial-walk channel kept at modest density (back-compat with current
                                     stand_walk_distance curriculum) so brains trained under either curriculum
                                     transition consistently.
  gated_walk_bonus_rate    = 0.20  ⇒ NEW channel: chassis_y_norm × v_norm × 0.20 hits/tick.  Fires densely when
                                     brain is BOTH upright AND moving radially outward; fails closed if either
                                     condition isn't met.  At full upright + full target velocity → 0.20 hits/tick
                                     bonus, matching legacy standing density.

Reward regime totals (hits/tick at the three regimes):
  standing only:                   0.05 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.05  (¼ legacy standing density)
  standing + radial walking:       0.05 + 0.05 + 0.20 = 0.30  (1.5× legacy standing density)
  walking without standing (fall): 0.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00

Reward gradient: 6× between standing-only and standing+walking.  Multiplicative coupling ensures the bonus
stream can ONLY be earned by doing both at once — brain can't farm one channel to ignore the other.

Phase 7.10b — phase_contrast_gain=0.7.  Multiplicative factor on gated bonus = (1 - 0.7) + 0.7 × inter_diag_contrast.  Reward differential is 3.3× between proper trot (diagonals anti-phase, contrast=1.0 → factor=1.0) and bound/pronk (all 4 legs together, contrast=0.0 → factor=0.3).  Brain learns to alternate diagonals because that's how the full gated bonus is earned.
